title: Mother Superior update — eight gold modules, one live equity curve
author: Livid_Parsnip_2816
selftext:
Several people asked for an update on the MT5 gold system I shared previously, so here’s a closer look at how it works and what the live chart actually shows.



Mother Superior runs eight individually switchable strategy modules on XAUUSD. Each module manages its own entries and basket separately. DCA spacing is based on ATR, allowing the distance between additional entries to adapt to volatility. Basket exits target a net profit after accounting for trading costs.



It uses increasing position sizes during adverse moves. That makes the difference between balance and equity particularly important: the green line shows closed results, while the blue line includes floating P/L. The recovery on the chart followed a substantial floating decline, so the rising balance curve alone would give an incomplete picture.



Trading was quieter during the recent election and NFP period. It held up well over that particular week, although one event-heavy week cannot establish how it will behave in future conditions.



The attached October 1–November 6 snapshot shows +34.51% account growth. It is still a short live sample. My focus going forward is on overlapping exposure between modules, basket duration and floating drawdown—not just the final return.



Eight modules still trade the same underlying asset, so separate entry logic does not automatically mean independent risk. That’s one of the main things I’m watching as the live record develops.



Disclosure: I’m the developer, and the EA is available commercially.
